x-request-contract.idempotency: current authorized projection of the committed effect; not a stored historical response body
x-request-contract.replay: Successful DELETE with the same key replays204 while current enclosing scope/action remains authorized. Access loss is never bypassed.

post.x-sync-contract: Per-page commits, not atomic repository sync. Each continuation requires a fresh UUIDv4 key and If-Match equal to the last returned project_version. x-teamwork-text-contract.shape: TextValue={inline,ref}; exactly one is non-null. TextRef is data, not a credential or file URL.
x-teamwork-text-contract.resolve: GET ref.href using If-Match=context_version; follow next_offset until complete. Offsets count Unicode characters, not UTF-8 bytes.
x-teamwork-text-contract.consistency: All sections and TextRefs must share one context_version. CONTEXT_CHANGED409 restarts complete traversal with bounded retries; after three immediate attempts pause/preserve the local draft.

x-teamwork-throttle-contract: No application Team Work limiter or application429. Reserved concurrency is not admission control.
x-teamwork-counts-contract: Parent counts and last_activity_at are own-node only; Team totals sum matching roots+children once. Comment counts include tombstones; task counts include archived nondeleted tasks.
